item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Arjun's pinhole camera. He points the tiny hole at a lit candle and looks at the tracing-paper screen at the back.

What should appear on the screen?

options.A: An upside-down image of the candle, also reversed left to right.
options.B: An upright image of the candle, reversed left to right.
options.C: A bright circular patch matching the round shape of the pinhole, not an image of the candle.
options.D: An upside-down image of the candle even if the pinhole faces away from the candle.
